text: ATEGUA, or ATEGUA, an ancient town of Spain, placed by fame in the road from Antiquars, now Antquers, a Filipin, or Seville, or others near Aleala Reil; which left in the more probable fi-tuation, because the flumen fallum, now the Salado, was in its neighborhood. Now _Teleda Prins, or Yrtede._
